text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 392 Lauder Avenue for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the criteria of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918 in that the Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where the subject property has access to on-site parking on the flanking street in the form of a two car garage. The owner will be given an opportunity to make a deputation before Community Council.

Etobicoke York Community Council approved the request for front yard parking at 392 Lauder Avenue, with the following conditions: 1. The parking area be a minimum of 2.2 metres in width and not exceed 2.5 metres and a minimum of 5.3 metres and not exceed 5.8 metres in length. 2. The applicant remove the existing asphalt and brick paving and repave the parking area with semi-permeable paving materials, as indicated in Attachment 'A', attached to the report dated May 10, 2018, from the Manager, Right of Way Management, Transportation Services. 3. The applicant disconnect any downspouts, if feasible, or seek an exemption from Toronto Water in accordance with the requirements in Chapter 681-11(S). 4.
